def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    space = groups[1]
    time_part = groups[2]
    combined = int(f"{date_part}{time_part}")
    layout = [len(space)]
    return {'stored': [combined], 'layout': layout}

def inverse(record):
    combined = str(record['stored'][0]).zfill(12)
    layout = record['layout']
    space = ' ' * layout[0]
    return f"{combined[:6]}{space}{combined[6:]}"
